work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief XVIII confirms the Angers Good Shepherd generalate; the congregation’s eight numbered articles LF3355–3445 are expressly inserted ipsissimis verbis (LF3350–3352) and approved LF3466–3471, so they are integral papal text, not separate acts. LF3408 → LF3420 across provenance LF3411, margin speck LF3414 and running title LF3417; LF3490 → LF3496 across page number LF3493; complete 3 April 1835 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF3295–3295; the source closing at LF3499–3502 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die tertia aprilis millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quinto, pontificatus Nostri anno quinto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
